name: Roomba 205 DustCompactor Combo (US)

radios.note: iRobot's page mentions the Roomba Home app and voice assistants but does not state Wi-Fi or its band.

matter.note: No Matter statement on iRobot's page or fast facts sheet, and no CSA listing was found.

apple_home.note: iRobot says it works with Siri-enabled devices; that is voice control, not a Home app accessory. Apple Home support not confirmed.

google_home.note: iRobot says it works with Google Assistant-enabled devices.

alexa.note: iRobot says it works with Alexa-enabled devices.

smartthings.note: No iRobot or Samsung page found for SmartThings.

home_assistant.note: The official Roomba integration says it does not work with newer x05 Wi-Fi models, naming the 105, 405 and 505. It does not name the 205, so support is not confirmed.

hubRequired.note: It ships with a standard charging dock, which is not a hub.

localControl.note: No maker statement on local-only control found.

cleaning.note: Vacuum only, mop only or both, with a washable microfiber pad.

navigation.note: Maps the home and stores up to 3 maps.

suctionPa.note: iRobot states suction only as a comparison to the Roomba 600 series, not in pascals.

selfEmptying.note: No self-emptying dock: the robot compacts debris onboard, which iRobot says lasts up to 60 days, and ships with a standard charging dock.

summary: Roomba 205 DustCompactor Combo works with Alexa and Google Assistant-enabled devices, according to iRobot, which also mentions Siri, though that is voice control only. It vacuums, mops or does both, and maps with ClearView LiDAR (up to 3 maps). There is no self-emptying dock: it compacts debris onboard, which iRobot says lasts up to 60 days. No Matter support turned up.
caveats: iRobot mentions Siri, but that is voice control, not a Home app accessory, so Apple Home isn't confirmed.
No Matter statement exists on iRobot's pages, and no CSA listing was found.
The Home Assistant Roomba integration says newer x05 Wi-Fi models don't work; it names the 105, 405 and 505, not the 205.
